explanation: His birth name was Temüjin; Genghis Khan was a title. By his death in 1227 his empire stretched from northern China to the Caspian Sea.

claims.text: Temüjin united the Mongol tribes and was proclaimed Genghis Khan in 1206, founding the Mongol Empire.

Genghis Khan's birth name was Temüjin, and Genghis Khan is a title.
Genghis Khan died in 1227, when his empire reached from northern China to the Caspian Sea.
